description: One Polymarket market or event by its polymarket.com link, slug or market id: the Yes odds now, 24-hour and weekly change, spread, liquidity, volume, end date, the resolution rules, and the odds over the last day, week or month. For an event with several markets (like each Fed meeting), lists them all and charts the busiest unless the link names one. Read-only.
